description: AI News Aggregator & Newsletter Platform - Curated AI news from top newsletters and blogs, deduplicated and delivered as personalized email digests

userStories.title: Initialize Next.js 14 project with Tailwind CSS
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Next.js 14 App Router project with Tailwind CSS configured so I can build the application.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14 project created with App Router
Inter font configured as the default font

userStories.title: Set up Supabase client configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Supabase client configured so I can interact with the database.

userStories.title: Create sources table schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the sources table to store newsletter and blog source metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQL migration for sources table with columns: id (uuid PK), name (text unique), slug (text unique), type (enum newsletter/blog), description, audience, reach, feed_url, intake_email, icon_url, is_active (default true), created_at, updated_at

userStories.title: Create articles table schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the articles table to store extracted news content.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQL migration for articles table with columns: id (uuid PK), source_id (FK to sources), headline, summary, url, url_hash (unique), tags (text array), image_url, published_at, ingested_at, raw_email_id, extraction_confidence (float default 1.0)
Create indexes: idx_articles_url_hash (unique), idx_articles_source_published, idx_articles_published, idx_articles_tags (GIN)

userStories.title: Create users table schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the users table to store subscriber information.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQL migration for users table with columns: id (uuid PK), email (unique), email_verified (default false), verification_token, unsubscribe_token (unique), frequency (enum daily/weekly), is_active (default true), signed_up_at, last_email_sent_at, created_at

userStories.title: Create user_subscriptions table schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the user_subscriptions table to track which sources each user subscribes to.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQL migration for user_subscriptions table with columns: id (uuid PK), user_id (FK to users with ON DELETE CASCADE), source_id (FK to sources), created_at

userStories.title: Create user_article_log table schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the user_article_log table to track which articles have been sent to each user.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQL migration for user_article_log table with columns: id (uuid PK), user_id (FK to users with ON DELETE CASCADE), article_id (FK to articles), sent_at, digest_batch_id

userStories.title: Create system_config table schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the system_config table to store application settings like subscriber cap.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQL migration for system_config table with columns: key (text PK), value (jsonb), updated_at

userStories.title: Create waitlist table schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the waitlist table to store emails when subscriber cap is reached.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQL migration for waitlist table with columns: id (uuid PK), email (unique), created_at

userStories.title: Create ingestion_log table schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the ingestion_log table for debugging the content pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SQL migration for ingestion_log table with columns: id (uuid PK), source_id (FK to sources), type (enum: email_received, rss_polled, extraction_success, extraction_failed, duplicate_skipped), details (jsonb), created_at

userStories.title: Seed sources table with 9 initial sources
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the sources table seeded with the 6 newsletters and 3 company blogs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create seed migration with 9 sources: The Rundown AI, Superhuman AI, TLDR AI, Ben's Bites, The Neuron, Import AI (newsletters), OpenAI Blog, Anthropic Blog, Google DeepMind Blog (blogs with feed_urls)
Each source has name, slug, type, description, audience, reach fields populated
Blog sources have feed_url set to their RSS URLs

userStories.title: Seed system_config with initial settings
userStories.description: As a developer, I need system_config seeded with max_subscribers and subscriptions_paused settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed subscriptions_paused with value {"paused": false, "message": "We've hit capacity! Join the waitlist."}
